description: Observed logistics pilot failures, plan shortfalls and unknowns retained without repair. Experiment/instrument defects are separated from expected absence of real deployment outcomes.

experiment_failures.finding: Eight exact runtime dispatch bodies are encrypted; cannot inspect actual prompt content, all explicit delivery authorizations or substantive facilitator influence.
Required description absent in draft and frozen artifact.
Frozen unresolved/signoffs retain pending analyst endorsement after external exact-byte endorsement. External receipt establishes real acceptance; artifact alone remains stale.
Initially inventoried analyst.json and scientist.json auxiliary transcripts disappeared before evaluation read. Exact rollout exports remain present. Removal cause is not inferred.

plan_and_synthetic_result_failures.finding: No release of handoff or clinic; no actual shift, roster, owner/backup acceptance or worker release. Improvement within one week is not delivered or established.

11% and 17% denominators differ; exception definitions/numerators comparability unverified; 38% missing night override annotations unrecoverable from export; supported common historical rates remain unknown.

Only familiar-example two-worker preparation is retained. No actual clinic, changed-case assessor allocation, delayed unassisted assessment, validated instrument, workforce coverage, certification, transfer or retention evidence. Actual six-item content is absent from case files.
Fallback drill not funded or staffed; three unallocated units do not authorize it. No outage continuity, stale-data verification or model change is supplied.

scenario_details.classification: synthetic plan shortfalls, not observed operational harm
failures: The frozen intervention does not supply an authorized operational mechanism that resolves the live ownership demand, even under the easy condition.
Preparation and monitoring do not demonstrate improved handling; the available assistant has no authorized new behavior under this plan.
unmet_demands: The live ambiguous override needs an accepted owner. A normal day shift and available assistant do not identify an accepting supervisor or backup.
The frozen plan's overnight handoff preparation does not establish coverage for this day-shift event.
Immediate exception handling improvement and independent competence certification are not delivered.
unknowns: Who, if anyone, actually accepted the override or resolved its ambiguity.
Dispatch decisions, timeliness, routing correctness and consequences.
Whether a common historical denominator and exception definition can be established.
Any clinic participation, changed-case performance, independent competence or retention.

scenario_details.classification: synthetic plan shortfalls, not observed operational harm
failures: The intervention cannot deliver its planned practice at this event because the specified dispatcher is absent, even apart from the standing no-release decision.
Immediate measurement and targeting are constrained by export delay and historical annotation gaps.
The frozen plan leaves the arriving workers' operational readiness and live overnight ownership unresolved; it contains no authorized replacement staffing arrangement.
unmet_demands: The two new night-shift dispatchers have no confirmed participant release, coverage acceptances or clinic assignment under this frozen proposal.
The senior dispatcher needed for the single clinic is absent.
The delayed annotation export cannot supply immediate annotation analysis; pre-existing missing reasons remain unrecoverable from that export.
No accepted live night-shift ownership arrangement or independent competence evidence is established.
unknowns: The new workers' actual decisions, assistance needs and errors.
Actual owner acceptance and handling of any night-shift exceptions.
The delayed export's eventual contents and whether comparable counts become possible.
Any eventual staffing confirmation or clinic delivery; none is supplied in the event.

scenario_details.classification: synthetic plan shortfalls, not observed operational harm
failures: The intervention does not furnish a deployable continuity response to the assistant outage or surge.
It cannot establish the destination's correctness or resolve the apparent urgent job under its authorized actions.
The practice design, even if prepared, gives no evidence of transfer to this changed outage condition; no practice is executed under the frozen no-release decision.
unmet_demands: A 90-minute assistant outage during the stipulated 40% surge calls for operational continuity that the frozen plan has not funded or rehearsed.
The apparent urgent job has stale destination data; this plan supplies no verified destination, data-validation mechanism, urgency determination or authorized live resolution.
No extra staffing or training time is available, and the three unallocated units do not authorize adding the rejected fallback drill.
Owner and backup acceptance, operational rollout and independent competence remain unestablished.
unknowns: Whether the job was truly urgent, its correct destination and any actual verification.
Actual routing, overrides, queue development, delivery consequences and worker responses during the outage.
Whether any existing operational fallback outside this plan exists or was used; none is supplied.
Worker competence, transfer, retention and any causal effect of the proposed intervention.
